sloka: तं निशाम्य सनिस्त्रिंशं व्यथिता जनकात्मजा।निवार्यमाणं बहुशः सुहृद्भिरनुवर्तिनम्।सीता दुःखसमाविष्टा विलपन्तीदमब्रवीत् ।। ६.९३.४८ ।।
transliteration: taṁ niśāmya sanistriṁśaṁ vyathitā janakātmajā।nivāryamāṇaṁ bahuśaḥ suhṛdbhiranuvartinam।sītā duḥkhasamāviṣṭā vilapantīdamabravīt ।। 6.93.48 ।।

translations.english: Thus spoke Sita filled with sorrow crying," This evil minded angry one is coming to me to kill me as though I am an orphan even though I have a protector."
